_about: English titles for kitab headings, keyed by the Arabic title as the Ifta' Sunnah table of contents gives it (vowel marks ignored, hamza seats kept). These are HadithCritic translations, made to read as natural English rather than transliteration. The Arabic title is always shown beside them.
